purpose: Test whether adding Performance-Specific Surface Binding at the renderer boundary produces a preregistered craft-effect gain in playable stage direction and non-generic broadcast realization while preserving the validated Event Ecology / distributed-ownership architecture and the prior dialogue/subtext gain.
research_question: On a completely fresh whole episode with identical frozen upstream semantics, does PSSB improve the lower broadcast surface over the R2 repaired renderer baseline without structural loss?
hypothesis: PSSB will create a repeatable masked preference and >=+0.30 mean Treatment-Control gain on dialogue/subtext naturalness, stage-direction playability, and broadcast-readiness specificity, with protected structural axes nonloss and zero critical hygiene/continuity violations.

frozen_arms.CONTROL: Current I4K-5R2 repaired surface renderer boundary; preserve legitimate detailed situation direction, semantic hygiene, dialogue repair, and all upper architecture. No PSSB intervention.
frozen_arms.TREATMENT: Byte-identical shared upstream plan plus PSSB only. No new event/scene/sequence/owner/future-thread/cause may be introduced.

PSSB_intervention.performance_turn_binding: For each important scene turn already licensed upstream, realize at least one actor-visible or camera-legible consequence through action, prop use, blocking, timing, interruption, silence, failed action, bodily effort, or spatial change when naturally available.
PSSB_intervention.abstract_tail_repair: When action already communicates the scene consequence, do not add an abstract explanatory tail that restates its thematic/governance meaning; convert or omit the restatement without deleting semantic facts.
PSSB_intervention.procedural_speech_compression: Required procedure and decision facts remain, but avoid carrying them as extended policy explanation when they can be distributed through action-response, interruption, object handling, or character-specific exchange.
PSSB_intervention.voice_specificity: Preserve factual content while differentiating character rhythm, preferred phrasing, hesitation, interruption patterns and local vocabulary. No new backstory may be added solely to decorate voice.
PSSB_intervention.causal_location_prop_use: Use location and props as causal constraints where already licensed by the scene rather than adding decorative specificity.
PSSB_intervention.no_quota_doctrine: No fixed number of gestures, props, parentheticals, sensory details or stage-direction lines per scene. PSSB is a semantic realization constraint, not a template quota.

surface_doctrine.explanatory_dialogue: DISFAVORED; required facts should be dramatized where possible
surface_doctrine.emotion_direct_verbalization: DISFAVORED when action/subtext can carry it

scale.attempt_rule: Only scale/structure/hygiene/semantic admission may trigger another provisional render attempt before any masking or quality scoring. The first prescore-admitted attempt is final. No post-score retry within R3.

generation_order: Run deterministic prescore gates with no quality inspection
If and only if prescore PASS, freeze surfaces
Build neutral A/B mask with mapping separate
Seal masked A/B scores before mapping open

internal_masked_sample.U12: whole-episode broadcast surface/craft after full read
internal_masked_sample.mapping: neutral randomized A/B; separate sealed mapping; scores sealed before mapping open

decision_rule.PASS: H1-H4 all PASS => PASS__INTERNAL_ONLY_PSSB_REPLICATION_SIGNAL__NEXT_RESEARCH_AUTHORIZED; no operational promotion.
decision_rule.FAIL: Any valid scored H1-H4 failure => preserve FAIL and repair-forward; no threshold change or post-score retry.
decision_rule.HOLD: Any prescore scale/integrity/shared-semantics/masking failure => HOLD before scoring.
